card.name: Hedging or limiting words mid-sentence
card.fires_on: Qualifying words such as best, likely, only, actually, and commas that come just before a limiting or surprising statement in general web prose.

modes.label: Limiting adverbs
modes.description: Words like best, only, actually that narrow or correct a claim.
modes.example: at<< best>> you could say they assessed and provided feedback

modes.label: Comma before a letdown
modes.description: A comma after a short phrase, followed by a contrasting or diminished clause.

modes.label: Likelihood word
modes.description: Words like likely that introduce a predicted outcome.
modes.example: rapid emergence of HIV-1 resistance is<< likely>> to result because of the subtherapeutic
